Content type mapping broken for document parts

When opening Word documents, the content type mapping for document parts gets corrupted, causing issues with document parsing and content iteration.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Try to open any Word document
document = Document('example.docx')

# This will fail or produce unexpected results
sections = document.sections
content = list(sections[0].iter_inner_content())
```

The issue appears when the package reader processes content type overrides - the mapping gets reversed internally, breaking the association between part names and their content types. This affects document structure parsing and content access.
</issue>
